findings.message: Training needs about 337.26 GiB per GPU but H100 SXM (80 GB) has 80.00 GiB. Weights 15.26 GiB, gradients 15.26 GiB, optimizer 91.54 GiB, activations 215.21 GiB.
findings.hint: Activations dominate. Turn on activation recomputation, or reduce the micro-batch.

findings.message: Activations are 64% of the training footprint at batch 1 and 32768 tokens.
findings.hint: Full recomputation trades about 33% more compute for most of that memory.

findings.message: At 32768 tokens, attention is 39% of forward FLOPs.
findings.hint: The 2N and 6N rules of thumb quietly stop working here. Compare against the reported attention term rather than the parameter count.

findings.message: Serving needs about 95.55 GiB but H100 SXM (80 GB) has 80.00 GiB. Weights are 7.63 GiB and the cache is 72.00 GiB at 32768 tokens across 32 sequence(s).
findings.hint: The cache dominates. Reduce KV heads, shorten the context, or move some layers to a sliding window.

findings.message: The logits buffer is 23.18 GiB, which is 83% of all activation memory.
findings.hint: Compute the cross-entropy in chunks over the sequence so the full logits tensor is never materialized.

findings.message: At 32768 tokens, attention is 39% of forward FLOPs.
findings.hint: The 2N and 6N rules of thumb quietly stop working here. Compare against the reported attention term rather than the parameter count.

findings.message: 15000B tokens is 99.1x the compute-optimal budget of 151B. Heavily over-trained, in the range of small models trained on very large corpora.
findings.hint: This is fine when inference cost matters more than training cost, which is usually why it is done.
